title: Adding Tens and Ones: 40 + 7
seo_title: Grade 1 Adding Tens and Ones Worksheets (TEKS 1.3A)
standard_text: 1.3A use concrete and pictorial models to determine the sum of a multiple of 10 and a one-digit number in problems up to 99
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets for Texas TEKS 1.3A: add a multiple of 10 and a one-digit number with base-ten blocks, missing parts and stories. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number like 40 is 4 tens. A number like 7 is 7 ones.
  • 40 + 7: put the tens and ones together. 4 tens and 7 ones is 47.
  • You can add in any order: 7 + 40 = 47.

Examples

Example

40 + 7

4 tens and 7 ones

Answer: 47

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the digits40 + 7 is not 11.
Swapping the digits4 tens and 7 ones is 47, not 74.
Adding an extra tenCount the rods carefully.
